In relation to the peace process in Colombia, since 2013, FBA has conducted educational efforts, exchanged experiences, and provided technical advice regarding the ceasefire and disarmament, demobilization and reintegration of former combatants (DDR). FBA

Folke Bernadotteakademin (FBA) ansvarar tillsammans med Sida för genomförandet av Sveriges strategi för utvecklingssamarbete med Colombia 2017-2021. FBA:s arbete ska bidra till stärkt kapacitet att arbeta med konfliktförebyggande, fredsbyggande och jämställdhet.

Together with Sida, the Folke Bernadotte Academy (FBA) is responsible for the implementation of Sweden's development cooperation strategy with Colombia 2017-2021. FBA's work shall contribute to improved capacity in conflict prevention, peacebuilding and gender equality within the Security Sector.
